subject: ours:maintain-verification-skill
why: Owner ruling of 2026-11-15 (scratchpad/mvp-stack/owner-rulings-2026-11-13.md, last section, item 5; decision bead cr-r2pa.2.28.6, yes to both). Two rules added to the pass as three new traits of ours, the first rule's two mechanisms apart (critic-93b F1, README rule 1). generated-credentials-scanned-before-cleanup: before any cleanup or restart destroys a session's generated credentials, every kept file is searched for each of them through the helper, printing and saving no match; the launch-model, failed-drive and drift-restart cleanups wait for it (critic-93b F2); a match or an incomplete scan, a session whose credentials can no longer be checked, ends the pass blocked, the reply naming the file and the kind of match, or the session, never the credential. evidence-hashed-across-teardown: just before final teardown, after the last session's scan, the pass hashes every kept evidence file and checks the hashes after teardown; a changed hash ends the pass blocked, naming the file. The blocked outcome names both checks (82/proof-report.md lesson 5: pass 1 tore down by itself, so neither was possible; 82/proof-report-2.md Step 0: pass 2 did both through the coordinator, and an earlier cleanup had destroyed one session's credentials). fixed-command-driven-as-written: every documented command the pass corrected or added is driven exactly as written before it ships, whether or not the helper changed, a case left marked not yet driven exempt; a separate mechanism from harness-fix-redriven (critic-89b F1, which removed it pending this ruling; 82/proof-report-2.md lesson 3); maintain-formal-verification-skill also holds it (this round's second event). Tree hash refreshed; no other trait or note of the unit changed.
